title: Boston Gas Company files for approval a 306 Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Certain Teed Corporation.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also find that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protetion from public disclosure, pursuant to G.L. c.25 § 5D. Commissioners participating were: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Paul B. Vasington and Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr. (GC99-33)
